shared_elements: low-relief carving on a stone surface
justification: A shows a schematic animal-like figure in low relief on a narrow pillar face with sparse, isolated motifs, whereas B shows a large multi-spoked wheel with a hub, framed by patterned bands, a rosette/petal register and drapery-like garment folds. Beyond both being shallow relief carving with some incised lines, there is no shared motif, no shared relationship between elements, and the ordered horizontal registers of B have no counterpart in A.
